cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Agronomic advice is generated jointly with farm-economics reasoning: every recommendation is returned in free / low-cost / investment tiers with input-cost and ROI logic, so a smallholder with no budget and a farmer with capital receive materially different, actionable answers to the same question. The economics layer is not commentary appended to agronomy; it determines which agronomic action is recommended.

test_prompts.prompt: My maize in Murewa is yellowing on the older leaves and I have about $30 to spend this month. What should I do?
I farm 2 hectares of maize and groundnuts on sandy soil in Natural Region IV. People say this coming season will be a dry one. How should I plan my planting and spending?
